newsitem.title: USA: Michaels Stores Sept same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Michaels Stores Sept same-store sales up.

text.p: Michaels Stores Inc said Wednesday its sales in September increased by six percent to $95.5 million, while its same-stores sales increased by one percent during the month.
Chief Executive Michael Rouleau said the company has taken several steps to try to improve its position and to ready itself for the upcoming holiday season.
"However, in order to achieve a profitable third quarter, our same-store sales and margin will need to improve substantially," Rouleau said in a statement.
The September sales period was for the four weeks ended September 22.
For the year to date, sales were up seven percent to $744.4 million, while its same-store sales were down three percent.
